what: When 56px of a photo cell enters the screen, the inner plate rises from the cell bottom (100%) over .66s, while the photo inside descends from the top (−100%) in reverse, settling from 1.75x to 1x (curve 0.33,0,0,1). Plate and photo cross, so the photo seems to shrink almost in place while only the cell opens from below. Plays once.

options.delay: Delay (s), default 0 — use when it should be staggered from the text entrance in the same Section
options.zoom: Initial scale of the image, default 1.75 — at 1 it doesn’t shrink and only opens staggered
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default ”top bottom-=56」(Original: when 56px of the section is visible)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (if present) inner panel that rises — otherwise the first child
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: (if present) photo that sinks as it descends inside the panel — if absent, the panel’s first child

note: Give the cell a height (aspect-ratio etc.) and the panel and photo fill the cell completely (position:absolute; inset:0). The original uses an IntersectionObserver threshold of min(56px/section height, .5) — moved to ScrollTrigger start

from.where: index.html .kh-shop (hotspot photo — original Spark ImageReveal: .image__reveal-container y 100%→0, .image__img y −100%→0 · scale 1.75→1, duration .66, CustomEase 0.33,0,0,1)
